key_findings: Review: trigeminal (chemesthetic) stimulants such as capsaicin, AITC and piperine can enhance saltiness perception, offering a salt-reduction strategy.
Capsaicin activates TRPV1; AITC acts on TRPV1 and TRPA1; high NaCl can also stimulate TRPV1, and the TRPV1t splice variant may mediate the amiloride-insensitive salt taste pathway.
TRP channel activation can release substance P and CGRP from trigeminal neurons, causing vasodilation.
